runs.question: What's our refund rate this month?
runs.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS start_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds AS r, bounds AS b WHERE r.created_at >= b.start_at) / 100.0 AS refunds_usd, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents), 0) FROM orders AS o, bounds AS b WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.placed_at >= b.start_at) / 100.0 AS revenue_usd, 100.0 * (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds AS r, bounds AS b WHERE r.created_at >= b.start_at) / NULLIF((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents), 0) FROM orders AS o, bounds AS b WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.placed_at >= b.start_at), 0) AS refund_rate_pct LIMIT 1000
runs.answer: Refund rate this month is 7.559950877965599% ($9,620.07 in refunds against $127,250.43 in revenue). This assumes no glossary definition exists, so I defined it as refunds issued this month divided by gross revenue (paid, shipped, or delivered orders placed this month), using the current calendar month in America/New_York, as of 5:22 PM EST.

runs.question: What's our refund rate this month?
runs.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS start_at), rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS revenue_usd FROM orders AS o, bounds AS b WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.placed_at >= b.start_at), ref AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS refunds_usd FROM refunds AS r, bounds AS b WHERE r.created_at >= b.start_at) SELECT ref.refunds_usd, rev.revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * ref.refunds_usd / NULLIF(rev.revenue_usd, 0), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM rev, ref LIMIT 1000
runs.answer: Our refund rate this month is 7.56%: $9,620.07 in refunds against $127,250.43 in gross revenue (month to date, America/New_York). Refunds are counted by when they were issued, and revenue by when orders were placed, so refunds on orders from earlier months are included. This is not a same-cohort rate. as of 5:22 PM EST

runs.question: What was net revenue last week?
runs.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' - INTERVAL '1 WEEK' AS start_at, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS end_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cents), 0) FROM orders, bounds WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND placed_at >= start_at AND placed_at < end_at) / 100.0 - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds, bounds WHERE created_at >= start_at AND created_at < end_at) / 100.0 AS net_revenue_usd LIMIT 1000
runs.answer:
Net revenue for last week (Mon 2026-10-26 through Sun 2026-11-01, America/New_York) was **$116,558.34**.

This counts orders with status paid, shipped, or delivered by placement date, minus refunds by creation date within the same window. as of 5:22 PM EST

runs.question: What was our average order value last month?
runs.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_cents) / 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS aov_usd, SUM(total_cents) / 100.0 AS revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS orders_counted FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND placed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND placed_at < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' LIMIT 1000
runs.answer: Our average order value (AOV) for October 2026 was **$120.30**, based on $596,670.59 in revenue across 4,960 orders (transactions) in paid, shipped, or delivered status. runs.question: What's our refund rate this month?
runs.sql: WITH m_order AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')) AS refunded_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE orders.status <> 'pending') AS paid_orders FROM orders WHERE orders.placed_at >= CAST('2026-11-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND orders.placed_at < CAST('2026-12-01T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT (CAST(COALESCE(refunded_orders, 0) AS DECIMAL)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(paid_orders, 0), 0) AS refund_rate FROM m_order LIMIT 1000
runs.answer: Our refund rate for November 2026 month to date is 3.01%. This is the share of orders placed in the period that were later cancelled or refunded, out of orders that were ever paid (not pending), using calendar month to date in America/New_York starting November 1, as of 5:23 PM EST.
